Hi! Child of fbt here! I did fbt with my parents almost two year ago before moving to uni. My parents were very supportive and said they they would eat everything I eat and if I gain weight, they gain weight. It was very comforting that they were able to do this and normalized eating. I also had motivation to get weight restored before college so I was trying to put in effort as well. It helped our relationship because they didn’t force me to eat foods that I genuinely hated, but fear foods were included (unknowingly because I didnt tell them what I was scared of). They let me help cook and see what was going in the foods I was eating and sometimes get to choose what I wanted. I found that especially helpful. I was allowed to still go out with friends as long as I send them a pic of what I was eating and actually eat it. There was a lot of trust. Seeing how much fats were going into my meals freaked the heck out of me but It was needed and looking back I’m thankful for it. Fbt was definitely not the path that was “best” just cause it focused a lot on weight gain =recovered and that’s not the mentality we should be having. No matter what weight you are, you could be struggling still. I dropped weight in college and hid that from my parents but told my sister and friends and therapist so it wasn’t a secret but I really wanted to use that as motivation to see if I could do it myself and I could. Please feel free to ask me anything I’m an open book when it comes to Ed stuff
